source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 30ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιοι Αστέριος, Κλαύδιος, Νέων και Νεονίλλη τα αδέλφια»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 30 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry enumerates four siblings, each with his or her own heading, so it is four folders in principle; three are drafted and the fourth is not. The sister Neonilla is left undrafted because the corpus already keeps a folder «neonilla», display name Neonilla, a martyr with a Greek feast on 16 January, and this reader could not settle from these pages whether she is the same woman; the report says so. The corpus's only other Asterius is the companion of Thalaleus. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (1 October 2026).
